claims.title: Unrestricted simulator indistinguishability
claims.scope: observable probability laws on one measurable experiment
assumptions: the simulator class contains a member with the same observable law as the base model
nonclaims: does not show that simulations exist
does not make restricted simulator architectures untestable

claims.title: Likelihood-ratio evidence ceiling
claims.scope: two mutually absolutely continuous observable models
assumptions: the pointwise likelihood ratio lies between exp(-epsilon) and exp(epsilon)
nonclaims: does not supply or verify the physical likelihood model

claims.title: Observer-measure Jensen gap
claims.scope: nonnegative uncertain simulated observer measure with finite expectation
assumptions: base observer measure is fixed and positive
probability is defined by the stated observer-measure convention
nonclaims: does not establish the correct anthropic measure

claims.title: Adaptive approximate-rendering transcript bound
assumptions: conditional total-variation error is bounded at each matched prefix
nonclaims: does not estimate the error of any real physical simulator

claims.title: Approximate predictive-state packing lower bound
claims.scope: finite families of future observable laws
assumptions: one renderer state emits one approximating future law
each target law is approximated within epsilon in total variation
nonclaims: finite packing checks do not prove an asymptotic physical lower bound

claims.title: Fano multi-architecture identification lower bound
claims.scope: finite restricted architecture families with a uniform prior
assumptions: candidate observable distributions are correctly specified
IID relaxation is used only where explicitly stated
nonclaims: does not define the correct architecture family or prior

claims.title: Selection log-odds sensitivity identity
nonclaims: does not assert that a simulator uses outcome-dependent retention

claims.title: One-sided Bernoulli likelihood-ratio e-process
assumptions: the observations satisfy the declared Bernoulli sampling model
the fixed alternative lies on the tested side of the null boundary
nonclaims: an anomaly indicator is not generic evidence for simulation
the repository does not verify IID sampling for external data

claims.title: Local physical-computation envelope
claims.scope: devices obeying the physical assumptions behind Landauer, Margolus-Levitin, Bekenstein, and Schwarzschild formulas
assumptions: input energy, temperature, radius, or mass is externally justified
nonclaims: does not constrain unknown parent physics without a transfer assumption

claims.title: Hierarchical feasibility model averaging
assumptions: scenario priors, data likelihoods, and observer measures are supplied and correctly interpreted
nonclaims: does not determine a uniquely correct prior or observer measure
does not reproduce an empirical probability that reality is simulated

claims.title: Quantum and relativistic predictive-state lower bounds
nonclaims: no uniform quantum or relativistic lower bound is currently claimed
